timeline.summary: Gulf Oil International (Mauritius) Inc. declared no encumbrance on Gulf Oil Lubricants India Limited shares for FY2026, signed by Camille Nehme, Authorized Signatory on April 2, 2026.

Gulf Oil Lubricants India Ltd schedules Earnings Conference Call on May 28, 2026, at 12:30 PM IST with Mr. Ravi Chawla (MD & CEO) and Mr. Manish Gangwal (WTD & CFO) to discuss Q4 & FY2026 Audited Financial Results.
Q4FY26 results (consolidated): revenue ₹1,055.26 Cr (+10.8% YoY), net profit ₹89.59 Cr (-3.5% YoY).
Gulf Oil Lubricants India Limited held an earnings conference call on May 28, 2026, discussing audited standalone and consolidated financial results for Q4FY26 and FY26.
Earnings Conference Call scheduled for Friday, October 30, 2026 at 3:30 PM IST for analysts and investors.
A fire broke out at Gulf Oil Lubricants India's warehouse in Valsad, Gujarat, with stock fully insured and no casualties reported.

watchlist.text: Shareholder approval for final dividend at the AGM
